sources.entry: Equinox - Create dynamic wallpapers for macOS. ![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/equinox-create-wallpaper/id1591510203?platform=mac)
Equinox - Equinox is an application that allows you to create macOS dynamic wallpapers.

summary.one_liner: Equinox is a macOS app for creating native dynamic wallpapers that change with the sun's position, the time of day, or the system Light/Dark appearance.
summary.what_it_does: Equinox lets you build macOS-native dynamic wallpapers by choosing a wallpaper type and dragging in your images. It offers three types: Solar, which uses the sun's position over the year; Time, which switches images on a schedule you define; and Appearance, which swaps between a Light Mode and a Dark Mode image. A built-in Solar calculator estimates sun position from the place, date, and time a photo was taken, or from a Sun timeline when the exact time is unknown, and the result can be dragged onto an image. The README says wallpapers are exported and then set via right-click, Services, Set Desktop Picture. The README also describes a FAQ workaround for wallpapers that do not update, and a way to test by changing the system date and time.
use_cases: wallpaper that changes with time of day
light and dark mode desktop background
estimate sun position for a photo
make Dynamic Desktop wallpaper without Apple tools
how_to_run: Download Equinox from the App Store (linked in the awesome-mac listing) or from the project's releases.
Choose a wallpaper type: Solar, Time, or Appearance.
Drag and drop your images into the app and configure the schedule or sun position.
Right-click the exported wallpaper and choose Services → Set Desktop Picture.
If it does not change over time, set Desktop & Screen Saver to a Dynamic type first, as described in the FAQ.
notable: Creates wallpapers using macOS-native Dynamic Desktop and Light & Dark Desktop formats
Solar calculator estimates sun position from place, date, and time, or from a Sun timeline
Available on the Mac App Store according to the awesome-mac listing
Translated into around ten languages, with a documented translation workflow
caveats: Requires macOS 12.0 (Monterey) or later for the current version; macOS 10.14 and 10.15 need Equinox 6.0.
Wallpapers may not change over time due to a macOS issue unless Desktop & Screen Saver is set to a Dynamic type first.
The README mentions a donation option to support the project; no paid tier is described.
keywords: make wallpaper that changes during day
